newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Dainong Group cedes rights on Dainong, Midopa.
newsitem.headline: Dainong Group cedes rights on Dainong, Midopa.

text.p: South Korea's Dainong Group has agreed to give up management rights to Dainong Corp and Midopa Department Store to its main creditor SEOULBANK, a bank official said on Wednesday.
"Dainong Group has submitted a memorandum giving up the right to its stocks but we asked for additional necessary documents," he said. "When that's received, we'll provide 15.9 billion won in loans."
Creditors plan to grant 5.7 billion won in rescue loans to Dainong Corp and 10.2 billion to Midopa.
Aside from the emergency loan, the group earlier announced plans to curtail the number of group affiliates to four from 21 at present.

The group plans to focus on the remaining four units, Dainong Corp, Midopa, Dainong Heavy Industry Co Ltd and Metro Products Inc, which were slated for bail-out by a voluntary committee of financial institutions.
